---
# PacBio full-length 16S processing workflow for [PreMiEr Project/manuscript]
# Adapted from Benjamin Callahan's public PacBio pipeline:
# https://benjjneb.github.io/LRASManuscript/LRASms_fecal.html
# Project-specific modifications by Mengyi Dong
---

# Load libraries and directories
```{r}
#Install missing packages
BiocManager::install("dada2")
BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
BiocManager::install("seqTools")
```

```{r}
library(dada2)
library(Biostrings)
library(ShortRead)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)
library(phyloseq)

library(magrittr)
library(fs)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(tools)
library(seqTools)
```

#Set up path
```{r}
data.dir <- "/data/folder/16S" # CHANGE ME to location of the First Replicate fastq files

# Directories for temporary files 
path.out <- "/output/data/folder/temp_16S"
path.rds <- "/output/data/folder/temp_16S/RDS"

fns <- list.files(data.dir, pattern="fastq.gz", full.names=TRUE)

rc <- dada2:::rc

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
old <- Sys.time() # get start time
```

#Process data
##Remove primers and filter
```{r}
F27 <- "AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG"
R1492 <- "RGYTACCTTGTTACGACTT"

nops <- file.path(data.dir, "noprimers", basename(fns))
prim <- removePrimers(fns, nops, primer.fwd=F27, primer.rev=dada2:::rc(R1492), orient=TRUE)
```

##Length distribution
```{r}
lens.fn <- lapply(nops, function(fn) nchar(getSequences(fn)))
lens <- do.call(c, lens.fn)
hist(lens, 100)
```

##Filter
```{r}
filts <- file.path(data.dir, "noprimers", "filtered", basename(fns))
track <- filterAndTrim(nops, filts, minQ=3, minLen=1000, maxLen=1600, maxN=0, rm.phix=FALSE, maxEE=2)
track
```

#Run DADA2
## Dereplicate
```{r}
drp <- derepFastq(filts, verbose=TRUE)

saveRDS(drp, file.path(path.rds, "drp_derepFastq.rds"))

#Learn errors
err <- learnErrors(drp, errorEstimationFunction=PacBioErrfun, BAND_SIZE=32, multithread=TRUE)

saveRDS(err, file.path(path.rds, "DADA2_Derep_16S.rds"))

#Inspect errors:
plotErrors(err)
```

##Denoise
```{r}
dd <- dada(drp, err=err,BAND_SIZE=32, multithread=TRUE)

saveRDS(dd, file.path(path.rds, "DADA2_Denoise_16S.rds"))

#Read tracking
cbind(ccs=prim[,1], primers=prim[,2], filtered=track[,2], denoised=sapply(dd, function(x) sum(x$denoised)))

#Sequence table
st <- makeSequenceTable(dd)
dim(st)
```

#Taxonomy and Chimera
```{r}
tax <- assignTaxonomy(st, "/data/processing/Reference/gg2_2024_09_toSpecies_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE) # Slowest part
tax <- addSpecies(tax, "/data/processing/Reference/silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz")

tax[,"Genus"] <- gsub("Escherichia/Shigella", "Escherichia", tax[,"Genus"]) # Reformat to be compatible with other data sources
head(unname(tax))

# Check chimeras
bim <- isBimeraDenovo(st, minFoldParentOverAbundance=3.5, multithread=TRUE)
table(bim)

sum(st[,bim])/sum(st)

#Extract sample names from filenames:
file.names <- basename(fns)
sample.names <- sub(".*\\.hifi_reads\\.(.*?)\\.hifi_reads\\.fastq\\.gz", "\\1", file.names)
rownames(st) <- sample.names
sample.names

#Save processed objects
saveRDS(st, file.path(path.rds, "Sequence_Table_16S.rds"))
saveRDS(tax, file.path(path.rds, "Taxonomy_Silva138_VT_UPF.rds"))

#Reload processed data
st <- readRDS(file.path(path.rds, "Sequence_Table_16S.rds"))
tax <- readRDS(file.path(path.rds, "Taxonomy_Silva138.rds"))
```

#Metadata
```{r}
df <- read.csv("/data/folder/metadata_16S.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
head(df)
```

#Save and export as phyloseq object
```{r}
otus = otu_table(st, taxa_are_rows=FALSE)
sd = sample_data(df)
ps <- phyloseq(otus,
               sd,
               tax_table(tax))
```

```{r}
# Extract DNA sequences and add them as reference sequences 
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(ps)
ps@refseq <- dna
ps
```

```{r}
# Optional: Give ASVs numbers which are easier for graphing & analyzing than the full sequence 
taxa_names(ps) <- paste0("ASV", seq(ntaxa(ps)))  
ps
```

```{r}
# Export final phyloseq object and check that it was written and saved correctly
saveRDS(ps, file.path(path.rds, "ps_PacBio_16S.rds"))

ps <- readRDS(file.path(path.rds, "ps_PacBio_16S.rds"))
```

```{r}
new <- Sys.time() - old # calculate difference
print(new) # print in nice format
```

sessionInfo()
